parsed.why: State protections actually operating: public-accommodations and facilities access secured, GI hate-crime enforcement with conviction, care shield, open markers. Deductions only for the shared federal border/document regime and suspended youth coverage.

Low-risk tier, but protection rests on commission interpretation and regulation rather than statute, and no operative hate-crime remedy for anti-LGBTQ violence; recurring school-sports bills. Tolerant state layer under unfixed federal border regime.

Worst: statewide restroom ban criminalising use in government buildings including airports (tier-1 universal exposure) with no working remedy, markers closed as fraud, adult care barriers, no GI anti-discrimination or hate-crime coverage, travel advisory.

No facility ban and GI hate crime exists, but care ban covering minors plus Medicaid at any age, prison care bar, surgical marker requirement and licence-marker reversion, and no GI anti-discrimination law.

Most-protective tier with working enforcement: public-accommodation and facilities coverage plus complaints body, shield order reaching travellers, surgery-free and X markers, GI hate-crime enhancements, lowest recorded violence.
